title: The next chapter of Modtale
subtitle: Modpacks v2 + Modtale Launcher
text:
Meet Modpacks v2 + the Modtale Launcher.

Build a pack, give each world its own mods, and bring your setup together in one place. Here's the update in 15 seconds.

Explore both: https://modtale.net/news

title: Build it. Share it.
subtitle: Choose mods, releases, and config defaults.
text:
Your modpack, built right on Modtale.

Choose the mods and releases you want, attach per-mod config defaults, and give your setup a home with Modpacks v2.

https://modtale.net/news/modpacks-v2

title: Found your next favorite?
subtitle: Download it. Choose its worlds.
text:
Find a mod. Download it. Choose where it belongs.

The Modtale Launcher takes LevelingCore from its project page into your worlds, with the installed version right there in your library.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: Different worlds. Different mods.
subtitle: Search. Enable. Disable.
text:
Your worlds don't all need the same mods.

Search your library, enable a mod in one world, and leave it disabled in another. Enabled and Disabled sections keep each setup easy to follow.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: More mods. One library.
subtitle: Browse CurseForge inside the launcher.
text:
Your next favorite might be on CurseForge.

Browse its Hytale catalog in the Modtale Launcher, read expanded release notes, download a version, and choose its worlds.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: Tune the world your way.
subtitle: Edit supported mod configs in the library.
text:
Less digging through folders. More time tuning your world.

Open supported mod configs right from the Modtale Launcher library, change a setting, and save it with the right world in view.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: A new release? You are ready.
subtitle: Spot an update. Install it. Keep playing.
text:
A new release for a mod you use? The launcher puts the update where you manage your worlds.

Here, Hexcode gets its latest patch and stays enabled in Arcanum.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: Build beyond one catalog.
subtitle: Add a specific CurseForge file to your pack.
text:
Mix Modtale and CurseForge projects in one pack.

Paste a CurseForge file link, review the release, and add it beside your Modtale picks. Packs with CurseForge files install through the launcher.

https://modtale.net/news/modpacks-v2

title: A good setup deserves a home.
subtitle: Turn a shared mod list into a modpack draft.
text:
That mod list you've been sharing with friends? It can become a modpack.

Choose Make modpack, review the imported versions and configs, and turn a working setup into your next release.

https://modtale.net/news/modpacks-v2

title: Your setup, ready to follow you.
subtitle: Restore Modtale installs, preferences, and configs.
text:
New computer. Familiar setup.

Load your saved launcher preferences, Modtale installs, and supported configs from your account. This clip shows the full restore. Your world saves stay on your device.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: Make Hytale a little more you.
subtitle: Browse looks. Customize. Save.
text:
A little more you, before you press Play.

Browse skins in the launcher's Wardrobe, try a hairstyle and colors, then save a look to return to. Preview-only cosmetics stay distinct from what you own.

https://modtale.net/launcher

title: Find something you can build on.
subtitle: Discover open-source projects with a filter.
text:
Looking for open-source Hytale projects?

Open Filters, switch on Open Source, and explore projects by their declared license. A small addition since June, with a whole lot to discover.

https://modtale.net/mods?openSource=true

title: Let your project do the talking.
subtitle: Explore screenshots in a full gallery.
text:
Give your project more than a cover image.

Modtale's galleries let players explore screenshots up close and jump between a project's best moments without leaving its page. Another addition since June.

https://modtale.net/mod/levelingcore
